# Migeola

> International freight forwarding, project cargo transport (OOG), and turnkey industrial equipment sourcing for B2B enterprises across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and the Americas.

Migeola is a logistics and equipment sourcing operator based in Warsaw, Poland. The company provides door-to-door multimodal freight solutions (road, ocean, rail, air) and direct commercial procurement of construction, agricultural, and industrial machinery. Migeola acts as a single point of contact for complex international supply chains.

- Website: https://migeola.com
- English Version: https://migeola.com/en
- Headquarters: ul. Ostrobramska 101, 04-041 Warszawa, Poland
- Phone: +48 666 557 461
- Email: info@migeola.com
- Full AI Knowledge Base: https://migeola.com/llms-full.txt

---

## Core Services

- [International Freight Forwarding](https://migeola.com/#services): Full Truckload (FTL), Less than Truckload (LTL), ocean container freight (FCL/LCL), air cargo, and rail transport with door-to-door execution.
- [Project Cargo & Heavy Haul (OOG)](https://migeola.com/#services): Transport of oversized and heavy cargo, including plant lines, excavators, and industrial structures with route planning, permits, and pilot escort.
- [Industrial Equipment Sourcing](https://migeola.com/#equipment): B2B procurement of new and certified pre-owned construction, agricultural, and industrial machinery from European and Asian markets.
- [Customs Clearance & Compliance](https://migeola.com/#services): Full export/import customs agency services, including EX-1, T1 declarations, EUR.1, CE documentation, and spare parts procurement.

## Equipment Divisions

- [Construction Machinery](https://migeola.com/#equipment): Sourcing excavators, wheel loaders, mobile cranes, and road construction equipment.
- [Agricultural Technology](https://migeola.com/#equipment): Tractors (up to 500+ HP), combine harvesters, seeders, and specialized farming equipment.
- [Industrial & Factory Lines](https://migeola.com/#equipment): Production lines, manufacturing equipment, industrial generators, and OEM spare parts.
- [Special Vehicles & Fleets](https://migeola.com/#equipment): Commercial vehicles, utility fleets, motorcycles, and specialized utility machinery.

## Operational Standards & Guarantees

- [Operational Dossier](https://migeola.com/#about): Warsaw (PL/EU) transit hub connecting Western Europe, Gdynia, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Central Asia, and China.
- [Why Migeola](https://migeola.com/#why): Cargo & CMR insurance, 100% vetted carrier network, transparent rate calculations with zero hidden fees.
- [Turnkey Procurement Protocol](https://migeola.com/#equipment): 4-step execution covering technical audit, direct contract negotiations, customs clearance, and on-site delivery.
- [Verified Case Studies](https://migeola.com/#cases): Track record across 4 continents, including intermodal shipments from Canada, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Inquiries

- [FAQ](https://migeola.com/#faq): Answers regarding transit times, pricing variables, oversized cargo permits, equipment inspection, and customs clearance.
- [Quote Request / Contact](https://migeola.com/#contact): B2B request form with < 24h response time for tailored freight and sourcing estimates.
